assignments.title: Lab 04: A* Search Algorithm for Romania Route Finding
assignments.description: Implement A* Search to find the optimal path from Arad to Bucharest on the Romania map using straight-line distance heuristics h(n). Calculate total path cost g(n) and print the sequence of cities visited.

assignments.title: Lab 05: Minimax Algorithm with Alpha-Beta Pruning
assignments.description: Implement Minimax search with Alpha-Beta Pruning for a game tree of depth 3 with branching factor 2. Leaf utility values: [3, 5, 6, 9, 1, 2, 0, -1]. Identify root optimal value and count pruned branches.
